blinding_guess.why: All six packet elements are Gazebo C++ headers the plugin includes with the gazebo/ prefix; whether they exist and are API-compatible depends on the Gazebo version installed for hydro, which the snapshot does not pin and whose headers are outside the allowed sources. notes: All packet elements are consumed APIs (Gazebo headers); the package provides none of them, so declares and not_declared are empty. The code includes them as <gazebo/...> (gazebo_ros_kobuki.h:42-47; gzmath.hh also at gazebo_ros_kobuki.cpp:41); packet names omit the gazebo/ prefix and are recorded verbatim as given. Include path comes from pkg-config gazebo (CMakeLists.txt:5-8, 31-33) plus gazebo_ros via catkin; no Gazebo version is pinned in package.xml or CMakeLists.txt. Port fields msg_type/frame/units/definition_id are null because a header include carries no message type, frame or units, and header files are not definition files the tool can hash (Gazebo sources are not an allowed source). QoS null: ROS 1. No rates set. Symbols used from these headers include ModelPlugin, physics::ModelPtr/WorldPtr/JointPtr, event::ConnectionPtr/Events::ConnectWorldUpdateBegin, common::Time, math::Vector3/Quaternion/Pose, sensors::RaySensorPtr/ContactSensorPtr/ImuSensorPtr, sensors::SensorManager::Instance()->GetSensor, msgs::Contacts, GZ_REGISTER_MODEL_PLUGIN, gzdbg; casts use boost::shared_dynamic_cast (cpp:251-256, 301, 325).
